ideas.title: The Impact of the Head Start Overhaul on Vulnerable Children
ideas.description: Investigate the potential consequences of the Trump administration's proposed overhaul of the Head Start program on vulnerable children
questions: What are the potential consequences of the proposed changes to the Head Start program?
How will the changes affect vulnerable children?
ideas.insight: This story idea is important because it gets at the heart of the potential consequences of the proposed changes to the Head Start program. By investigating the impact on vulnerable children, we can shed light on the potential human cost of these changes.
